meta.notes: Keyboard accessories (keycap sets, switch packs, switch testers, pullers, wrist/palm rests, keyboard cables) researched 2026-09-28 from official manufacturer stores only: keychron.com, gloriousgaming.com, hyperx.com, novelkeys.com (Shopify product JSON), wooting.io, logitech.com, steelseries.com, razer.com (product pages). Prices are the brand's own US store prices on 2026-09-28. Switch colour options (Red/Brown/etc.) are switch types, so they are listed in configurations/variants rather than colors. Third-party switches resold by Keychron (Gateron, Kailh, Cherry) were deliberately excluded because their price source would be a reseller.
